detail.longDescription: Let your homelab patch itself overnight without the updates colliding Your homelab updates itself, and one morning something is down: a node rebooted mid-deployment, or a backup ran after the change it should catch. Nothing logged an error. One fixed nightly order stopped these collisions on my machines. https://www. michelebologna.net/2026/homela b-patches-itself-without-collisions/ # homelab # kubernetes # k3s # kured
